warnings.UNSUPPORTED_SERVICE: The patient requested a service that this clinic does not offer (e.g. CoolSculpting). The system will automatically escalate this message to a human operator to suggest alternative treatments.
warnings.PROVIDER_SPECIALTY_MISMATCH: The selected provider does not specialize in the requested service. Choose a provider with the correct specialty certification, or proceed with override justification.
warnings.CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT: Another booking has been made for the same provider at the same time. Select another slot or resolve the schedule override.
warnings.DO_NOT_BOOK: The patient has been marked 'Do Not Book' in the CRM system due to a clinical restriction or administrative notes. Bypassing this requires manager approval.

platform_guidelines.confidence_score: The confidence score measures how closely the incoming request matches standard booking rules. Factors include: 1. Clarity of the patient request intent (scheduling vs query), 2. Entity parser score (detecting date, time, and service cleanly), 3. Schedule match (no overlaps), 4. Specialty validation (provider is certified).
platform_guidelines.how_to_approve: To approve a booking, review the recommended candidate slot on the right-hand panel. Click 'Approve Proposal' to save it. If you need to make changes, customize the provider or time inline, type an override reason, and then click 'Approve Proposal'.
platform_guidelines.after_approval: After approval, the system: 1. Commits the appointment to the database, 2. Generates a PDF invoice receipt in the background, 3. Dispatches confirmation emails and SMS to the patient, 4. Sends a calendar .ics invite to both patient and provider.
platform_guidelines.candidate_ranking: Candidate slots are ranked by: 1. Patient provider preference (VIP match), 2. Provider daily utilization (prefers packing appointments tightly to avoid gaps), 3. Alignment with patient's preferred time of day (morning vs afternoon).

procedures.botox: Botox treatments take 15-30 minutes. Price is $15 per unit. Typical appointments take 30 minutes total.
procedures.lip_filler: Lip Filler treatments use dermal fillers (Juvederm/Restylane). Duration is 60 minutes. Price is $650 per syringe.
procedures.prp: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) facial treatments take 60 minutes. Price is $700 per treatment.
